title: Encore webhook event, schema_version 1
description: The JSON body Encore POSTs to a webhook channel. Every key is present on every event; a value the record does not have is null rather than absent, so a consumer can tell 'no cover art' from 'this build stopped sending the key'.

schema_version.description: Within one version every key is append only. Removing, renaming, or changing what a key holds moves this number.

event_type.description: Also sent as the X-Encore-Event header, so a consumer can route without parsing the body.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this release event. Deduplicate retries on it. Null only for channel.test, which is not a recorded event.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 in UTC, ending in Z. When Encore recorded the event, not when the release came out.

primary_type.description: MusicBrainz primary type (Album, Single, EP, ...). Null when MusicBrainz publishes none.

secondary_types.description: MusicBrainz secondary types (Live, Compilation, ...). An empty array means none, and is not the same as the key being absent.

first_release_date.description: MusicBrainz's partial date verbatim: 2027, 2027-03, or 2027-03-14. Never padded, because padding invents precision MusicBrainz did not publish.

cover_art.description: Cover Art Archive front-cover URL for the release group. Deterministic, and 404s when the archive holds no art: Encore does not verify it in advance, because that would cost a request per event.

plex.description: Deep link to the artist in the operator's Plex. Null until a Plex sync has learned the server's machine identifier, and null for an artist with no Plex row: a link built from a guess goes nowhere.
